ZinStdXml.Implementation: Pure Zin. No compiler XML/schema special case.
ZinStdXml.APIs: Tokenizer/pull parser is required. Higher-level DOM/tree API is optional but if allocating requires explicit allocator.
ZinStdXml.BootstrapUse: Stage-1 stdlib tooling uses std.xml to parse canonical Wayland XML and materialize std.wayland.
